facts_found: Business Silver Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back on eligible travel and software purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]
Business Silver Rewards Card earns 1.0% cash back on all other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

For the 10.0% rate, the merchant must process the transaction under a travel or software-related merchant category; multi-category merchants must code the charge to a qualifying category. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

Business Silver Rewards Card promo: new customers earn 2x cash back on all purchases for the first 6 months after account opening (travel/software 10.0% x2, other 1.0% x2); account must be opened between 2024-11-14 and 2025-11-14; no enrollment required. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

Business Silver Rewards Card cash back is credited to the account at the end of each billing cycle; merchant category exclusions continue to apply during the promo. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]
Silver Rewards Card earns 4.0% cash back on eligible travel and software transactions. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]
Silver Rewards Card earns at least 1.0% back on non-category (everyday) purchases. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_008]

Silver Rewards Card rewards are calculated after transactions post, not at authorization; pending earnings may adjust if the merchant updates the transaction or issues a credit. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

Silver Rewards Card transactions that typically do not qualify: gift cards, person-to-person payments, fees, interest, and insurance premiums charged by the bank; returned or refunded purchases have rewards reversed when credits post. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]
Silver Rewards Card rewards can be redeemed once the customer has at least 17 available. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_007]

For cash back cards including Silver Rewards Card and Business Silver Rewards Card, rewards are stored as points in the transaction database and 1 point = $0.01 cash back when redeemed as statement credit or checking account credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

Rho-Bank reward categories include Travel, Software, Media, Green/Sustainable, Operations, Transportation, Groceries, Dining, Entertainment, Utilities, Shopping, and Other (Other covers card-specific exclusions). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_005]

Business Silver Rewards Card offers annual travel credits of up to 50 and a foreign transaction fee of 1.5% (relevant to net value but not to earn-rate calculation). [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_010]

facts_found: Cash back discrepancies are handled through a 'cash back dispute' process that applies to all credit card transactions. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

The submission mechanism is a customer-run tool: submit_cash_back_dispute_0589(user_id: str, transaction_id: str); the agent instructs the customer to run it rather than following a step-by-step agent workflow. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

Agent notes require confirming the customer has the correct transaction_id before submission, and advise that supporting context (category or promotion expectations) may be requested later during review. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

Correction procedure applies only after a cash back dispute is resolved and approved; the agent must then update the affected transaction(s) with the correct rewards value. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Step 1 of correction: look up the user's resolved disputes in the cash_back_disputes database to find the transaction_id values needing rewards adjustments. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]
Step 2 of correction: use unlock_discoverable_agent_tool to unlock the agent tool update_transaction_rewards_3847. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Step 3 of correction: recalculate correct rewards per transaction from card type, transaction category, and applicable promotions; do not rely on the expected_rewards field in the dispute record — independently verify rates and eligibility. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Step 4 of correction: use call_discoverable_agent_tool to invoke update_transaction_rewards_3847 with transaction_id (exact identifier) and new_rewards_earned (string formatted 'X points' where X is the correct whole-number point value). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Post-correction compliance steps: confirm the update in credit_card_transaction_history after the tool call completes and retain calculation notes in the internal case record for auditability. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

The correction tool sets the transaction's rewards to an absolute corrected value (new_rewards_earned), so it can fix both under-credited and over-credited transactions. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id) returns all credit card disputes for a user including transaction_id, transaction_date, merchant_name, amount, currency, card_last4, status (e.g., open, under_review, closed), reason_code, outcome and internal notes — allowing transaction IDs to be obtained internally without customer statements. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

Customer-facing guidance confirms support can investigate cash back discrepancies, verify merchant category, check applicable reward rates and apply an adjustment when the customer was shortchanged; helpful inputs are transaction date, merchant name, amount, received vs expected cash back, and receipts. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

All credit card rewards points are rounded DOWN (floored) to the nearest whole number; this applies consistently across all card types and reward categories, so corrected values must be whole points. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]

Rewards for cash back cards (including Silver Rewards Card and Business Silver Rewards Card) are stored as points in the transaction database at 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as statement credit or checking account credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

Applying a checking-account credit is restricted to two circumstances only — missing rebates ('rebate_credit') and fee mischarges ('fee_refund') — so it is not a valid mechanism for a rewards/cash-back correction. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_017]

apply_statement_credit_8472 is the agent tool for goodwill adjustments, promotional credits, fee reversals or other account credits, with reason values including 'error_correction' and 'dispute_resolution'; it credits dollars to the card balance rather than correcting per-transaction rewards. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]

No transfer of funds between bank accounts is part of the rewards-correction procedure; transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 applies only to moving money between a customer's own checking/savings accounts. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_010]

Rewards are calculated after transactions post (not at authorization) and pending earnings may adjust if the merchant updates the transaction or issues a credit; returned/refunded purchases have rewards reversed when credits post. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

If a purchase is misclassified, the customer may be asked to provide receipts/invoices during a rewards review — documentation that this customer cannot supply from statements. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

Human transfer reason codes include 'complex_billing_dispute' (Tier 1) and 'technical_system_error' for cases requiring specialist review or when a system error prevents completion of the request. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

open_questions: The KB documents only customer submission of a cash back dispute (submit_cash_back_dispute_0589) and correction of an ALREADY resolved/approved dispute; no agent-side tool or procedure for approving/resolving a cash back dispute was found, so it is unclear whether the agent can move disputes to 'resolved and approved' or whether a human/specialist step is required.

No documented agent tool for retrieving raw credit card transaction history (transaction_id, amount, merchant category, rewards_earned) by user_id/date range was found — only get_user_dispute_history_7291 (disputes) and the post-hoc verification source 'credit_card_transaction_history'. The exact tool name to enumerate Feb–Nov 2025 transactions is not in the KB.

Whether a cash back dispute can be filed for a transaction without the customer supplying the transaction_id (i.e., whether the agent may run submit_cash_back_dispute_0589 on the customer's behalf) is not stated; the document says to instruct the customer to run it themselves.
No documented time limit / filing window for cash back disputes (e.g., whether Feb 2025 transactions are still disputable) was found.
Whether update_transaction_rewards_3847 can be called once per transaction or supports batch updates, and any rate limit, is not documented.

Whether the correction retroactively changes the already-credited billing-cycle rewards balance (cash back is credited at end of each billing cycle) or only the stored per-transaction value is not documented.

verified_facts: Step 2 of correction: use unlock_discoverable_agent_tool to unlock the agent tool update_transaction_rewards_3847. [source: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Step 3 of correction: recalculate correct rewards per transaction from card type, transaction category, and applicable promotions; do not rely on the expected_rewards field in the dispute record — independently verify rates and eligibility. [source: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Step 4 of correction: use call_discoverable_agent_tool to invoke update_transaction_rewards_3847 with transaction_id (exact identifier) and new_rewards_earned (string formatted 'X points' where X is the correct whole-number point value). [source: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Post-correction compliance steps: confirm the update in credit_card_transaction_history after the tool call completes and retain calculation notes in the internal case record for auditability. [source: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

The correction tool sets the transaction's rewards to an absolute corrected value (new_rewards_earned), so it can fix both under-credited and over-credited transactions. [source: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id) returns all credit card disputes for a user including transaction_id, transaction_date, merchant_name, amount, currency, card_last4, status (e.g., open, under_review, closed), reason_code, outcome and internal notes — allowing transaction IDs to be obtained internally without customer statements. [source: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

Customer-facing guidance confirms support can investigate cash back discrepancies, verify merchant category, check applicable reward rates and apply an adjustment when the customer was shortchanged; helpful inputs are transaction date, merchant name, amount, received vs expected cash back, and receipts. [source: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

All credit card rewards points are rounded DOWN (floored) to the nearest whole number; this applies consistently across all card types and reward categories, so corrected values must be whole points. [source: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]

Rewards for cash back cards (including Silver Rewards Card and Business Silver Rewards Card) are stored as points in the transaction database at 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as statement credit or checking account credit. [source: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

Applying a checking-account credit is restricted to two circumstances only — missing rebates ('rebate_credit') and fee mischarges ('fee_refund') — so it is not a valid mechanism for a rewards/cash-back correction. [source: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_017]

apply_statement_credit_8472 is the agent tool for goodwill adjustments, promotional credits, fee reversals or other account credits, with reason values including 'error_correction' and 'dispute_resolution'; it credits dollars to the card balance rather than correcting per-transaction rewards. [source: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]

No transfer of funds between bank accounts is part of the rewards-correction procedure; transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 applies only to moving money between a customer's own checking/savings accounts. [source: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_010]

Rewards are calculated after transactions post (not at authorization) and pending earnings may adjust if the merchant updates the transaction or issues a credit; returned/refunded purchases have rewards reversed when credits post. [source: doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

If a purchase is misclassified, the customer may be asked to provide receipts/invoices during a rewards review — documentation that this customer cannot supply from statements. [source: doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

Human transfer reason codes include 'complex_billing_dispute' (Tier 1) and 'technical_system_error' for cases requiring specialist review or when a system error prevents completion of the request. [source: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

facts_found: Business Silver Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back on eligible travel and software purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]
Business Silver Rewards Card earns 1.0% cash back on all other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

For the 10.0% rate, the merchant must process the transaction under a travel or software-related merchant category; multi-category merchants must code the charge to a qualifying category. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

Business Silver Rewards Card promo: new customers earn 2x cash back on all purchases for the first 6 months after account opening (travel/software 10.0% x2, other 1.0% x2); account must be opened between 2024-11-14 and 2025-11-14; no enrollment required. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

Business Silver Rewards Card cash back is credited to the account at the end of each billing cycle; merchant category exclusions continue to apply during the promo. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]
Silver Rewards Card earns 4.0% cash back on eligible travel and software transactions. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]
Silver Rewards Card earns at least 1.0% back on non-category (everyday) purchases. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_008]
